task.title: M01 RED tests
task.description: Write meaningful RED regression tests for split routing entrypoint lifecycle. Read actual code and reproduce rules sync/distill overwriting short index. Exercise sequence/repeat, flags/security/user blocks; include pair-write error observability/recovery where existing IO seams allow. Do not implement source. Return test_case_specs with exact test files/run command and RED evidence.

acceptance_criteria: AC1: M01: init, rules sync, rules distill, update and repeated sequences preserve a short index plus full routing document through a shared writer; enabled module/security flags and user-owned entrypoint blocks are preserved.

AC2: M01: orient/catalog and related consumers resolve the split entrypoint, regression fixtures assert correct ownership of both documents, failed pair publication is observable and recoverable on rerun without a false success.
constraints: Use local tests-creator skill and testing context; graph/wiki before deeper reads, keryx ctx rg only for code search.
Only write lane-owned tests and artifacts. No implementation code. No commits/staging/checkout/push; parent owns git.
Do not edit flow.json or frozen acceptance criteria; parent owns all flow transitions.
commit_test_stubs=false: shared feature branch with simultaneous workers.
Stats disabled; no external model calls, no private dataset copying.
Do not modify unrelated files. Coordinate shared test file ownership before edits.
Return STATUS first and validate subagent-result; persist RED command/output and test_case_specs in artifacts.
